episodeTitle.en: Strategies for becoming less distractible and improving focus | Nir Eyal
episodeTitle.zh: 提升专注力、减少分心干扰的策略 | 尼尔·埃亚尔

guestBioOfficial.en: Nir Eyal is the author of two best-selling books, Hooked: How to Build Habit-Forming Products and Indistractable: How to Control Your Attention and Choose Your Life. He writes, consults, and teaches at the intersection of psychology, technology, and business. His books have sold over 1 million copies in more than 30 languages; he has taught at Stanford’s Graduate School of Business and its Design School; and he has started and sold two startups since 2003. In our conversation, we discuss: • Strategies for becoming less distractible and improving focus
guestBioOfficial.zh: 尼尔·埃亚尔（Nir Eyal）是两本畅销书《上瘾：如何打造让人上瘾的产品》和《心无旁骛：如何掌控注意力，选择人生方向》的作者。他在心理学、科技和商业的交叉领域进行写作、咨询和教学。其著作已在30多种语言中售出超过100万册；他曾在斯坦福大学商学院和设计学院任教；自2003年以来，他已创立并出售了两家初创公司。在我们的对话中，我们探讨了：• 提升专注力、减少分心的策略

title.en: Strategies for becoming less distractible and improving focus | Nir Eyal
title.zh: 提升专注力、减少分心干扰的策略 | 尼尔·埃亚尔

summary.en: Nir explains that distraction is not a character flaw but a failure to plan, and introduces a four-step model - master internal triggers, make time for traction, hack back external triggers, and prevent distractions with pacts - to become indistractable. He stresses that the root cause of distraction is often our attempt to escape discomfort, and that scheduling values-based time weekly is more effective than reactive to-do lists. The conversation is packed with practical tactics for regaining focus and doing the work that matters.
summary.zh: Nir 指出，分心不是性格缺陷，而是缺乏规划的结果，并提出了四步模型来变得“不可分心”：掌控内在诱因、为“专注”预留时间、回击外部干扰、用约定（pact）防止分心。他强调，分心的根源往往是我们逃避不适感，而每周基于价值观安排时间，比被动的待办清单更有效。本期充满了重新夺回注意力、去做真正重要之事的实用技巧。
